response.sql: WITH event_totals AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) AS total_spent, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), event_ratios AS (SELECT event_id, total_spent / NULLIF(total_amount, 0) AS spend_ratio FROM event_totals), scored AS (SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / NULLIF(AVG(spend_ratio) OVER (), 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, relative_ratio FROM scored ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each event’s spend ratio is the sum of its nonmissing spent values divided by the sum of its nonmissing budget amounts; the comparison average is the unweighted average of nonmissing event ratios. Zero total budget yields a missing ratio.

alternatives.interpretation: Ignore a budget line unless both spent and amount are present, then aggregate only those complete lines for each event.
alternatives.sql: WITH event_totals AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) AS total_spent, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM budget WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), event_ratios AS (SELECT event_id, total_spent / NULLIF(total_amount, 0) AS spend_ratio FROM event_totals), scored AS (SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / NULLIF(AVG(spend_ratio) OVER (), 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, relative_ratio FROM scored ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
